name: ReadyWise 84 Servings Gluten-Free Emergency Food Supply Bucket
summary: One gluten-free bucket with 84 labelled servings across four recipes. ReadyWise declares 15,420 kcal, corroborated by the inspected yogurt-dessert label version; servings are not complete meals.
description: The recorded WGF01-184 listing is for one 84-serving gluten-free bucket, with rice, tortilla soup, a potato entrée and yogurt-style dessert in separate pouches. The manufacturer contents list and inspected back label agree on 15,420 declared kcal when their serving counts are combined. These are rounded label values, not laboratory measurements or a promise that every lot has the same formulation. Plan potable water and preparation equipment, then check the labels, dates and seals of the delivered pouches.

specs.label: Documented assortment
specs.value: One bucket, 13 pouches: 24 Teriyaki Rice, 18 Hearty Tortilla Soup, 18 Potatoes & Chicken Flavored Pot Pie and 24 Creamy Yogurt Style Dessert servings; 84 servings are not 84 complete meals

specs.label: Declared energy
specs.value: 15,420 kcal per reference bucket, declared by ReadyWise and corroborated using the inspected label values; rounded nutrition figures, not independently measured energy

specs.label: Teriyaki Rice
specs.value: 6 servings per reference pouch; 270 kcal per 76 g labelled serving

specs.label: Hearty Tortilla Soup
specs.value: 6 servings per reference pouch; 160 kcal per 44 g labelled serving

specs.label: Potatoes & Chicken Flavored Pot Pie
specs.value: 6 servings per reference pouch; 190 kcal per 47 g labelled serving

specs.label: Creamy Yogurt Style Dessert
specs.value: 8 servings per reference pouch; 110 kcal per 25 g labelled serving

specs.label: Water planning
specs.value: About 63 cups for the reference bucket; use the instructions on the delivered pouches and plan drinking water separately

specs.label: Preparation
specs.value: Reference entrées require heating; the yogurt-style dessert mixes with water. Follow each delivered pouch for water quantity, temperature and preparation time

specs.label: Storage claim
specs.value: Up to 25 years under suitable unopened-pouch storage: cool, dry and protected from moisture, oxygen and light. Check dates and seals; no unconditional lifetime guarantee

pros: Several dish types can complement a broader food reserve.
Sealed pouches allow the contents to be prepared separately.
cons: Requires potable water and a practical preparation/heat plan.
Serving values may be rounded and formulations can differ; 84 servings are not 84 complete meals.
Gluten-free does not mean allergen-free. Check every delivered pouch, dates, seals and storage instructions.
useCases: Plan a household food reserve alongside water, cooking equipment and familiar shelf-stable foods.
Compare labelled portions and calories with household needs instead of counting servings as days or meals.

confirmed.text: ReadyWise lists one gluten-free bucket with 4 rice, 3 soup, 3 potato-entrée and 3 yogurt-dessert pouches: 13 pouches and 84 servings, not 84 complete meals.

The inspected label gives 270/160/190/110 kcal per serving for rice/soup/potato entrée/yogurt dessert. Combined with 24/18/18/24 servings, the calculation is 6,480 + 2,880 + 3,420 + 2,640 = 15,420 declared kcal. This corroborates the manufacturer total for this label version, not an independent energy measurement.
The separately linked vanilla-pudding sheet gives 100 kcal per serving. It is a different dessert reference and is not substituted for the inspected yogurt-style label at 110 kcal.

The owner reports Canadian ASIN B00TX5J74S, model WGF01-184, UPC 851238005318 and GTIN 00851238005318 for one 84-serving gluten-free bucket. The model/UPC pair is also present in the cited retailer catalogue; neither statement authenticates a current Amazon seller or delivered lot.

unverifiedClaims: The current Canadian offer, seller, actual delivered formulation, dates and package integrity are not independently verified. Nutrition figures are manufacturer-declared and may be rounded; no laboratory test or identical formulation across all lots is claimed.
safetyNotes: Gluten-free does not mean allergen-free. The inspected rice label declares soy; the potato entrée and yogurt dessert declare milk. Check all delivered ingredients and allergen labels.

The inspected back label warns of shared equipment processing milk, soy, wheat, egg and tree nuts. Do not infer dietary suitability from the concept illustration or transfer generic ingredient claims between formulations.
Remove oxygen absorbers before preparation. Use potable water and follow delivered-pouch instructions, including heating where required.
Store unopened pouches as instructed; inspect dates and seals. Up to 25 years is a conditional manufacturer maximum, not a guarantee for every lot or after opening.
publicationBlockers: Independent live-listing, delivered-variant and safety review remains required before full editorial publication.

Delivered lot, dates and allergen labels remain checks before use. The old pudding link does not override the inspected yogurt formulation, and no laboratory nutrition or unconditional shelf-life guarantee is made.

This permits the recorded link without claiming a live offer, seller authentication, laboratory testing or identical formulation in every lot; allergens, dates and storage limits remain disclosed.

purchaseChecks: Recheck WGF01-184 / B00TX5J74S as one 84-serving gluten-free bucket, not a 72-, 120- or 240-serving variant.

Match the four delivered recipes, including Creamy Yogurt Style Dessert, and read each nutrition/allergen label; do not replace them with a pudding sheet or interpret 84 servings as 84 pouches or complete meals.
Plan about 63 cups of preparation water for the reference assortment, plus drinking water, and follow the actual pouch cooking instructions.
